body.title: Hub staged route 404 from failed Vercel builds + CORS list replacement
body.summary: cg-apps-hub /api/dashboard/documents/staged stayed 404 when pnpm-lock.yaml stale (ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE). After route shipped, HUB_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS env replaced satellite list and dropped Document Center until union fix.
